verdict.stance: Overweight / Tier-1 Chevron-Operated Supergiant Oil Field (XS2010030083)
verdict.summary: TCO ramped its $48bn+ FGP-WPMP Third-Generation Plant (3GP) in 2025, delivering 39.0m tonnes of crude and $10.6bn in fiscal payments to Kazakhstan ($10.2bn in 9M26). Low lifting costs and Chevron/ExxonMobil/KMG sponsorship provide deep credit protection on the $750m 3.25% Aug-30 senior secured notes (XS2010030083), offset by CPC pipeline concentration.

positives: World-class Tengiz supergiant field with FGP-WPMP 3GP capacity online (39m tonnes in 2025).
Strong sponsors (Chevron 50%, ExxonMobil 25%, KMG 20%, Lukoil 5%) and senior secured structure.
Strategic Energy market positioning in Kazakhstan supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: Single-export corridor concentration via Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC) through Russia.
Private JV financial statements limit granular quarterly EBITDA/FCF disclosure.
Exposure to Kazakhstan macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.
